missing_features: Crawler fails to actually crawl and index pages from seed URLs (e.g., https://httpbin.org/html). Caused by pages_crawled only incrementing after successful indexer.add_document, which returns None if extracted text yields no tokens. Thus, even when a page is fetched successfully, the progress line and summary report show 0 pages crawled, and the inverted index remains empty, making search return no results.
bugs: In crawl_manager._worker, pages_crawled is only incremented when indexer.add_document returns a valid doc_id. If text extraction produces an empty string or tokenization filters out all tokens (e.g., due to a parsing quirk with the specific HTML), the page is silently dropped without updating pages_crawled or pages_failed. This leads to a permanent 0 crawled count and an empty index, even though the page was successfully fetched.
RobotHandler._ensure_parser uses parser.read() without a timeout, which can hang indefinitely if the robots.txt endpoint is unresponsive, potentially stalling the entire crawl.
